name: stub-occurrence-order
description: Stub mode. The same host operation (search_web, same args_hash) runs three times. Stubs match on (tool, args_hash, occurrence) and are consumed in order, so calls 1 and 2 get results A and B. Call 3 has no stub: it fails closed with unmatched_external_op, is settled not_sent, and never goes live.
